title: Dragon's Maze/Intro packs
description: MTG Wiki (Category:Return to Ravnica block intro packs)

paragraphs.text: Dragon's Maze has five bicolored guild-centric intro packs .
Azorius Authority is a white / blue intro pack centering around the Azorius Senate .
1 Lavinia of the Tenth
2 Sunspire Gatekeepers
The rares in this deck are Lavinia of the Tenth (holographic foil) and Martial Law .
Orzhov Power is a white / black intro pack centering around the Orzhov Syndicate .
3 Bane Alley Blackguard
1 Teysa, Envoy of Ghosts
2 Ubul Sar Gatekeepers
The rares in this deck are Teysa, Envoy of Ghosts (holographic foil) and Crypt Ghast .
Rakdos Revelry is a black / red intro pack centering around the Cult of Rakdos .
1 Exava, Rakdos Blood Witch
2 Smelt-Ward Gatekeepers
1 Sinister Possession
The rares in this deck are Exava, Rakdos Blood Witch (holographic foil) and Havoc Festival .
Gruul Siege is a red / green intro pack centering around the Gruul Clans .
1 Ruric Thar, the Unbowed
The rares in this deck are Ruric Thar, the Unbowed (holographic foil) and Skarrg Goliath .
Simic Domination is a green / blue intro pack centering around the Simic Combine .
2 Opal Lake Gatekeepers
1 Vorel of the Hull Clade
The rares in this deck are Vorel of the Hull Clade (holographic foil) and Gyre Sage .
